about: Fernhollow's night shift: a made-up night, like the rest of Fernhollow. The page shows it as last night's report and what would run tonight. Undo, Show me and the Tonight ticks change only the page: nothing runs.

window.words: Made up: Claude Code's weekly limit starts again at 03:00, before you're back at 07:00, with 38% unused. The night shift may use up to 28% of it (80% of that, keeping 10 points in hand). Codex: at your pace, about 12% of its weekly limit would be left unused when it starts again on Tuesday.
